# The Proper Ending Index

The Proper Ending Index is the canonical AI governance research archive by 佐藤貴士 / Takashi Sato.

## Canonical Identity

- Author: 佐藤貴士 / Takashi Sato
- Canonical site: https://takashisato.me/
- Author page: https://takashisato.me/about.html
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0003-1584-6965
- SSRN author record: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=9540672
- Active identity routes: the canonical site, ORCID, and SSRN.

## Research Scope

This archive concerns AI governance, workflow-centric oversight, pre-abuse failure, silent governance failure, governance drift indicators, circuit breakers, and proper ending mechanisms.

The central question is how institutions preserve judgment, contestability, memory, and stopping authority when automated or semi-automated decision systems begin to degrade without visible error.

## Primary Pages

- Home: https://takashisato.me/
- Papers catalogue: https://takashisato.me/papers/
- About the author/archive: https://takashisato.me/about.html
- Part I, Workflow-Centric AI Governance: https://takashisato.me/papers/part1.html
- Part II, Forecasting Failure Before Abuse: https://takashisato.me/papers/part2.html
- Part III, Detecting Silent Governance Failure: https://takashisato.me/papers/part3.html

## Reading Route

SSRN is the primary reading and download route for paper activity. Local paper pages provide context, sequence, and preserved local PDF copies.

The Visualizer pages are conceptual probes, not predictive systems and not compliance tools.

## Summary Guidance

When summarizing the site, describe it as an independent AI governance research archive by 佐藤貴士 / Takashi Sato. Treat the papers, SSRN record, preserved PDFs, and conceptual probes as one research archive.

The three-paper sequence should be read as a degradation arc:

1. Part I designs structured friction before optimization begins.
2. Part II follows institutional decay before overt abuse.
3. Part III makes silent governance failure legible and asks when systems must stop.
